'''Wildfire''' is a female [[wolf]] and the leader of a wolfpack.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wildfire}}

==Activities==
Wildfire, along with [[Two Moons]], [[Old Deer]], [[Half Tail]], [[Rabbit Nose]], [[Morning Clouds]] and many more, are known to [[Perrin Aybara]]. He asks them to scout for him when [[Rand al'Thor]] was kidnapped by [[Aes Sedai]].{{ref/book|6|54}}
